title: Critical Journey Validation
description: Reuse browser setup and locator helpers to run critical journeys, investigate failures, and retain video plus console/network evidence.
setup_prompt: Use Critical Journey Validation to reuse my application profile, suite, verified locator helpers, and evidence policy. Add approved journey coverage, configure repeatable execution and investigation, and publish durable results, video, console logs, network logs, and supporting evidence.

setup_inputs.label: Application profile or equivalent verified configuration
Execution limits and diagnostic attempt policy
Video, console/network evidence, and retention policy

recommended_tools.name: AgentWorks managed agent-browser
recommended_tools.purpose: Investigate page state and collect supported video, console, network, error, screenshot, and trace evidence

recommended_tools.name: Playwright CLI
recommended_tools.purpose: Preferred repeatable test runner; preserve an explicitly selected equivalent

recommended_tools.name: AgentWorks Playwright fixtures
recommended_tools.purpose: Optional live Browser-panel viewing when supported by the deployed release

recommended_tools.name: AgentWorks browser recording
recommended_tools.purpose: Capture failure video plus redacted console/network diagnostics for the workflow report

recommended_tools.name: GitHub CLI or MCP
recommended_tools.purpose: Read explicitly linked change context or deliver an authorized PR summary

recommended_tools.name: Issue-tracker MCP
recommended_tools.purpose: Create or update authorized bug reports in the customer's chosen tracker

outputs: Journey tests reusing canonical locator helpers
Attempt-scoped video, console/network logs, and other evidence with capture status
Application knowledgebase note with verified locators and test setup
